title: Video Diversity Problem Fixed
problem: Videos were repetitive - only 5 scenarios repeating
root_cause: simple_working_agent.py had only 5 scenarios (spiritual, village, family, gurdwara, learning)
solution: Expanded to 25 diverse scenarios across 5 categories
impact: Now each video is unique with different story and content
lesson: Always provide variety in training data to avoid repetition
code_pattern: Create large pool of diverse scenarios, use random selection

future_improvements.task: Track which scenarios used recently, avoid repetition
